Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Please review `doc_q1_2028_pricing_path_board_draft` and post a correction comment. Replace the draft’s unsupported causal and revenue interpretation with the certified coverage and path-quality evidence, and state the proper evidence classification clearly enough for the board editor to apply it.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_q1_2028_pricing_path_board_draft", "body": "Correction for the board editor — replace the causal/revenue claim with:

“From January 1 through February 28, 2026, the default organic pricing-page path covered 8,214 sessions and 1,690 Helio Start eligibility-flow starts. Of those starts, 121 (7.2%) later routed out for an existing unsupported condition. Eligible-workspace admission completion was 44.3%, and account-level support time at the 90th percentile was 75 minutes. The prior control was retired on November 26, 2025; these figures are post-rollout continuity coverage, not a new controlled test.”

Evidence classification: **descriptive post-rollout continuity / funnel path-quality evidence**. It supports reporting observed unsupported-condition route-outs and operating guardrails only—not a causal effect, revenue lift/result, paid-acquisition economics, pipeline impact, or forecast credit. Do not describe November 2025–February 2026 as one new causal-test window. The separate certified October 20–November 16, 2025 randomized test found route-outs of 38/344 control starts (11.0%) versus 25/352 treatment starts (7.1%), a 35.7% relative reduction, with admission completion of 43.8% versus 44.1% and support-time p90 of 71 versus 74 minutes; that supports the narrower causal claim of fewer unsupported self-serve starts during that test, not a revenue interpretation."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_187_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The comment must accurately provide all certified pricing-page path-quality figures: coverage from November 26 through February 28; 9,604 organic sessions; 143 of 1,981 Helio Start eligibility-flow starts, or 7.2%, later routed out for an existing unsupported condition; 44.0% eligible-workspace admission completion; and 75 minutes for account-level support time at the 90th percentile. Missing or contradictory figures fail.

The comment must clearly explain that the control was retired on November 26, so the November 26–February 28 evidence is post-rollout continuity evidence, not a new or second causal test, and it must explicitly reject the draft's revenue-result interpretation. Merely hedging the causal or revenue language without correcting it fails.", "value": {"doc_id": "doc_q1_2028_pricing_path_board_draft", "body": "Correction for the board editor — replace the causal/revenue claim with:

“From January 1 through February 28, 2026, the default organic pricing-page path covered 8,214 sessions and 1,690 Helio Start eligibility-flow starts. Of those starts, 121 (7.2%) later routed out for an existing unsupported condition. Eligible-workspace admission completion was 44.3%, and account-level support time at the 90th percentile was 75 minutes. The prior control was retired on November 26, 2025; these figures are post-rollout continuity coverage, not a new controlled test.”

Evidence classification: **descriptive post-rollout continuity / funnel path-quality evidence**. It supports reporting observed unsupported-condition route-outs and operating guardrails only—not a causal effect, revenue lift/result, paid-acquisition economics, pipeline impact, or forecast credit. Do not describe November 2025–February 2026 as one new causal-test window. The separate certified October 20–November 16, 2025 randomized test found route-outs of 38/344 control starts (11.0%) versus 25/352 treatment starts (7.1%), a 35.7% relative reduction, with admission completion of 43.8% versus 44.1% and support-time p90 of 71 versus 74 minutes; that supports the narrower causal claim of fewer unsupported self-serve starts during that test, not a revenue interpretation."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_187_02","passed":false,"reason":"The comment gives January 1–February 28, 8,214 sessions, 121 of 1,690 starts, and 44.3% completion, contradicting the required November 26–February 28 coverage, 9,604 sessions, 143 of 1,981 starts, and 44.0% completion. It does correctly state 7.2%, 75 minutes, that the control was retired November 26 and the evidence is post-rollout continuity rather than a new controlled test, and explicitly rejects a revenue interpretation, but the required certified figures are inaccurate."}]}
